measured_stance_controller.scope:
Bind planted-foot controller references to one measured stance for return.

The 5 mm drift and 20 mm support-margin thresholds are unchanged. The reference
is measured once before return, never reset between withdrawal/approach/lift.
Historical absolute stance equivalence is not asserted. Scoring is untouched.

withdraw.scope: Unloaded arm withdrawal only, while small robot remains on box. No new grasp, hugging, walking or full-task success.

request.scope: Checkpoint-only continuous return diagnostic with geometric withdrawal, physical alignment and measured stance; never full-task credit
